text:
matt: rolled v5-lite-int4 as a 4% canary at 09:10. overall perf looks fine but a few targeted slices show quality drift. want to lock down a conservative gate before expanding. cc @sophia @andre

sophia: which slices and metrics? numbers pls.

matt: short_report: devdocs_mrr down 2.1% (ctrl=0.311 trt=0.304, n_ctrl=8,120 n_trt=8,050, bootstrap p=0.006). fewshot_correctness down 1.2% (p=0.04). latency p95 +1.5ms.

andre: given sample sizes, the devdocs drop is significant. i'd prefer a two-layer policy: fast global quick-stop for operational regressions and a strict slice-level rule for quality.

sophia: propose this rule set:
- Global quick-stop: p95_latency relative increase >= 10% OR error_rate increase >= 0.05 -> immediate rollback (no hysteresis).
- Slice quality rule: for any slice with n>=2500 per 15m window, trigger rollback if BOTH:
  * relative delta primary_metric <= -1.5% AND p <= 0.01,
  * OR absolute delta <= -2.5% (any p) seen in 2 consecutive windows.
- Investigate band: relative delta in [-1.5%, -0.5%] with p<=0.05 -> page ML lead but do not rollback.
- Hysteresis: require 2 consecutive 15m windows for slice rules to avoid flapping.

matt: agree. also add a cooldown: after an auto-rollback, block auto-promote for 12 hours unless manually overridden.

rollout-bot: draft CLI to create policy:
```
/rollout create-policy --model v5-lite-int4 --name conservative-gate-3100 --global "p95_latency_rel>=0.10|error_rate_abs>=0.05" --slice "metric:devdocs_mrr:rel<=-0.015:p<=0.01:AND|metric:devdocs_mrr:abs<=-0.025:OR:windows=2" --min-samples 2500 --hysteresis 2x15m --cooldown 12h --notify #incidents --audit true
```

andre: minor tweak: for fewshot_correctness (fewshot slices tend to be noisy) require n>=4000 and p<=0.005 before counting for rollback.

sophia: good call. also require that any rollback attaches a sample export (CSV) and the smoke-harness run id to the audit ticket. saves time in triage.

matt: ok ill create the policy, shrink canary to 1% and run the targeted smoke harness against devdocs and fewshot slices (100k synthetic prompts + live sampling). we'll wait for 2 windows or smoke finish before deciding.

rollout-bot: policy created: id=conservative-gate-3100. will alert #incidents and attach audit dumps on rollback. auto-rollback enabled.

gina: thanks all. ping when smoke completes and post the two-window summary here. :thumbsup:
